title: 前沿LLM领域级元认知监控：33模型图谱
summary: 对33个前沿LLM在MMLU基准的6个领域进行元认知质量分析，发现聚合指标掩盖了领域级差异。应用/专业知识监控最容易，形式推理和自然科学最难。家族内轮廓聚类显著，但不同模型家族表现不同。结果支持在部署前进行基准领域筛选。
summary_en: Analysis of metacognitive quality across 6 MMLU domains for 33 frontier LLMs reveals aggregate metrics mask domain-level variation. Applied/Professional knowledge is easiest to monitor, Formal Reasoning and Natural Science hardest. Within-family profile clustering is significant for some families. Results support benchmark-stage domain screening before deployment.
